step1.description:
Create T3 App is a newish full-stack solution template built on top of Next.js. It was created only about 6 months ago but has already garnered a lot of attention. Christopher Ehrlich, a CT3A maintainer, will show me the ropes and help me understand what it looks like to be using the best patterns with React today.
